lines.text: This is the codebase explainer template. Replace this script with yours.
So what does it actually do?
It turns a codebase into a video like this one: researched, verified, narrated, and animated.
First, map the codebase and split it into subsystems. Then research each one in parallel.
Verify every number against the source. Write the script. Generate the voice, which fixes the timing.
Why does the voice come before the visuals?
Because every animation is keyed to a spoken line. Record first, and the visuals always land on the words.
Accuracy over polish. Explain the why, not the file tree.
